### Individuals (`ds_individuals`)

In this dataset (`ds_individuals`) each row represents an individual at a time point.

```{r}

# Join datasets (time points and culture info)

ds_individuals <- lapply(time_points,
                         function(time_point_i) {
                           read.csv(here("data", "individuals", paste0("t", time_point_i, ".csv")))}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  select(time_point,
         day,
         file,
         culture_ID,
         mean_area,
         N_frames) %>%
  left_join(culture_info,
            by = "culture_ID") 
```

```{r}

# Columns

ds_individuals = ds_individuals %>%
  select(
    time_point,
    day,
    file,
    culture_ID,
    system_nr,
    eco_metaeco_type,
    flow,
    flow_ml,
    patch_size,
    patch_size_ml,
    trophic_type,
    metaecosystem,
    metaecosystem_type,
    patch_size_ml,
    mean_area,
    N_frames
  ) %>%
  rename(patch_type = eco_metaeco_type,
         body_area_µm2 = mean_area)
```

```{r}

# Levels

ds_individuals <- ds_individuals %>%
  mutate(patch_type = case_when(patch_type == "AutoS_absolute" ~ "Green small isolated (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "AutoSM_absolute" ~ "Green small-medium isolated (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "AutoML_absolute" ~ "Green medium-large isolated (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "AutoL_absolute" ~ "Green large isolated (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroS_absolute" ~ "Blue small isolated (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroSM_absolute" ~ "Blue small-medium isolated (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroML_absolute" ~ "Blue medium-large isolated (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroL_absolute" ~ "Blue large isolated (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "AutoS_relative" ~ "Green small isolated (s)",
                                patch_type == "AutoSM_relative" ~ "Green small-medium isolated (s)",
                                patch_type == "AutoML_relative" ~ "Green medium-large isolated (s)",
                                patch_type == "AutoL_relative" ~ "Green large isolated (s)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroS_relative" ~ "Blue small isolated (s)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroSM_relative" ~ "Blue small-medium isolated (s)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroML_relative" ~ "Blue medium-large isolated (s)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroL_relative" ~ "Blue large isolated (s)",
                                patch_type == "AutoS_absolute_connected" ~ "Green small connected (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "AutoSM_absolute_connected" ~ "Green small-medium connected (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "AutoML_absolute_connected" ~ "Green medium-large connected (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "AutoL_absolute_connected" ~ "Green large connected (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroS_absolute_connected" ~ "Blue small connected (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroSM_absolute_connected" ~ "Blue small-medium connected (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroML_absolute_connected" ~ "Blue medium-large connected (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroL_absolute_connected" ~ "Blue large connected (s*d)",
                                patch_type == "AutoS_relative_connected" ~ "Green small connected (s)",
                                patch_type == "AutoSM_relative_connected" ~ "Green small-medium connected (s)",
                                patch_type == "AutoML_relative_connected" ~ "Green medium-large connected (s)",
                                patch_type == "AutoL_relative_connected" ~ "Green large connected (s)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroS_relative_connected" ~ "Blue small connected (s)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroSM_relative_connected" ~ "Blue small-medium connected (s)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroML_relative_connected" ~ "Blue medium-large connected (s)",
                                patch_type == "HeteroL_relative_connected" ~ "Blue large connected (s)",
                                TRUE ~ patch_type))  # If none of the above conditions are met, keep the original value

ds_individuals = ds_individuals %>%
  mutate(file =  as.numeric(str_extract(file, "\\d+")),
         patch_type = factor(patch_type,
                             levels = patch_types_ordered))
```
